free_text: The 72-year-old male has a PSA of 4.1 and a prior biopsy grade of 3+4 (ISUP Grade Group 2). MRI revealed a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right peripheral zone, classified as cT1c. The management assessment is to review individual treatment benefit and preferences. The trade-off involves balancing the risk of progression with the potential benefits of active treatment given the localized, low-risk finding.
